subject: Re: Self-signup Demo — Dedicated capacity calendar triage & latency SLOs
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@starmetrics.io>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (self‑signup)

Hi Chloe,

I just signed up via the self‑serve demo form and wanted to follow up with a bit more context so we can make the session useful. We are Starmetrics — building a real‑time analytics feature that will call the model for ranking/scoring at ~100–150 QPS peak with P50 latency budget of ~120ms, P99 under 450ms. Typical requests are 256–512 tokens input, responses ~64 tokens.

We are evaluating Redwood Dedicated because we need predictable throughput and to keep inference in a VPC. Our procurement/ops lead (ops@starmetrics.io) will join.

Preferred times next week: Tue/Thu mornings PT, but flexible. Can you confirm what information you need ahead of the call (workload profile, sample prompts, security checklist)?

Thanks,
Sara Kline
Head of Product, Starmetrics
[attachment: starmetrics_slo_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)]

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@starmetrics.io>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (self‑signup)

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and for uploading the SLO matrix. Great timing. I own the demo coordination for demos tied to Dedicated capacity.

Quick asks from our side to make the session high‑velocity:
- Can you confirm expected average RPS vs peak (you listed 100–150 QPS; is 100 sustained or short bursts?)
- Any strict P99 target under 450ms or is that a soft goal?
- Will the workload include streaming responses or plain completion tokens?

Suggested format: 45m call — 15m intake (workload & security), 20m walkthrough of Dedicated runtime/expected throughput, 10m next steps (procurement, pilot). Ben (AE) and Marcus (solutions engineer) can join for QPS sizing; copying them.

I can propose a few slots via Calendly — what about Thu 22 Apr 9:30–10:15 PT or Tue 27 Apr 10:00–10:45 PT? If neither works, drop 2 windows that do.

I attached a short ops checklist that helps us prepare (networking, sample payloads, preferred model families).

Chloe Martin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[chloe_martin@redwood.com]
[attachment: redwood-demo-ops-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)]

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (self‑signup)

Folks — forwarding the Starmetrics intake. Key points:~100–150 QPS peak, inputs ~256–512 tokens, P50 ~120ms target, P99 target stated as <450ms. Ops will join. They asked for a short intake and Dedicated walkthrough.

Proposal: reserve a 2‑GPU Dedicated pool for the pilot demo (we can scale in followups) — Marcus, can you run a quick sizing using 2xA100‑like profiled kernels and see if 100 sustained QPS at their token ranges is feasible with batching of ~16? If not, suggest fallback (quantized model, more GPUs, or lower batch target).

Ben — when you speak with procurement, please confirm if a PO timeline exists (they mentioned procurement lead). I'll send the calendar invite once we lock slot. Priyom — can you own the pre‑call intake and request sample payloads + network checklist from ops@starmetrics.io?

Thanks —
Chloe

From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@starmetrics.io>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: ops@starmetrics.io
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (self‑signup)

Chloe — Thu 22 Apr 9:30 PT works for us. Ops will send sample payloads (small set of representative requests) and our network/ingress CIDR for VPC peering.

One quick note: we do have some burst windows up to ~220 QPS for short (1–2 min) periods during batch reingestion. If you could note any degradation modes during the walkthrough that would be helpful (e.g., fallback to lower batch sizes, autoscale thresholds).

Looking forward to the call. Please send invite and any pre‑call form we should fill out.

—Sara
